chunks: They made for him whatever he wished, synagogues and statues, dishes large as water-troughs, and cauldrons firmly fixed
Act, O House of David, and give thanks
But few among My creatures are thankful.

key_terms.مَحَارِيبَ: prayer niches or places of worship

ai.seo_question: What did the Jinn build for Prophet Sulaiman and what is the meaning of 'O House of David'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the subjugation of Jinn to Prophet Sulaiman (AS) as a divine miracle, with 'structures' (maharib) often interpreted as palaces or places of worship, and 'utensils' (jifan) as large basins for cooling water. The command to 'Al-Dawud' (the House of David) serves as a bridge between the two prophets, emphasizing that their shared kingdom was a trust requiring profound gratitude, a virtue noted as rare among God's servants.

en.ahmedali: They made for him whatever he wished, synagogues and statues, dishes large as water-troughs, and cauldrons firmly fixed
(on ovens; and We said): "O House of David, act, and give thanks."
But few among My creatures are thankful.
en.ahmedraza: They made for him whatever he wished – synagogues and statues, basins like ponds, and large pots built into the ground;
“Be thankful, O the people of Dawud!”
And few among My bondmen are grateful.
en.arberry: fashioning for him whatsoever he would -- places of worship, statues, porringers like water-troughs, and anchored cooking-pots.
'Labour, O House of David, in thankfulness;
for few indeed are those that are thankful among My servants.'
en.daryabadi: They worked for him whatsoever he pleased, of lofty halls and statues and basins like cisterns and cauldrons Standing firm.
Work ye, house of Da'ud! with thanksgiving;
few of My bondmen are thankful.
en.hilali: They worked for him what he desired, (making) high rooms, images, basins as large as reservoirs, and (cooking) cauldrons fixed (in their places).
"Work you, O family of Dawud (David), with thanks!"
But few of My slaves are grateful.
en.itani: They made for him whatever he wished: sanctuaries, statues, bowls like pools, and heavy cauldrons.
“O House of David, work with appreciation,”
but a few of My servants are appreciative.
en.maududi: They made for him whatever he would desire: stately buildings, images, basins like water-troughs and huge, built-in-cauldrons:
“Work, O house of David, in thankfulness
(to your Lord). Few of My servants are truly thankful.”
en.mubarakpuri: They worked for him as he desired on Maharib, Tamathil, large basins like Jawab and Qudur Rasiyat.
"Work you, O family of Dawud, with thanks!"
But few of My servants are grateful.
en.pickthall: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground.
Give thanks, O House of David!
Few of My bondmen are thankful.
en.qarai: They built for him as many temples as he wished, and figures, basins like cisterns, and caldrons fixed [in the ground].
and few of My servants are grateful.’
en.qaribullah: They made for him whatever he wanted, arches, statues, bowls as basins, and fixed cauldrons.
(We said:) 'Give thanks, House of David and work'
Yet only a few of My worshipers are thankful.
en.sahih: They made for him what he willed of elevated chambers, statues, bowls like reservoirs, and stationary kettles.
[We said], "Work, O family of David, in gratitude."
And few of My servants are grateful.
en.sarwar: They would make for him anything that he wanted like fortresses, statues, large basins like reservoirs, and huge immovable cooking pots.
It was said, "Family of David, worship and act gratefully.
Only few of my servants are grateful."
en.shakir: They made for him what he pleased of fortresses and images, and bowls (large) as watering-troughs and cooking-pots that will not move from their place;
give thanks, O family of Dawood!
and very few of My servants are grateful.
en.transliteration: YaAAmaloona lahu ma yashao min mahareeba watamatheela wajifanin kaaljawabi waqudoorin rasiyatin
en.wahiduddin: They made for him whatever he desired: palaces and statues, basins like reservoirs, and large cooking vessels fixed in their places.
We said, "Give thanks, house of David,
for few of My servants are truly grateful."
en.yusufali: They worked for him as he desired, (making) arches, images, basons as large as reservoirs, and (cooking) cauldrons fixed (in their places): "
Work ye, sons of David, with thanks!
but few of My servants are grateful!"
